title: Canada pledges 500 million euros toward Ukraine support loan amid 2027 budget shortfall
summary: The Canadian contribution follows similar announcements made by other allies. Norway pledged $9 billion for 2027 on Oct. 7, and on Oct. 28, the U.K. announced a $13 billion pledge to Ukraine, its largest ever.

title: Russian attacks kill 5, injure at least 46 as Ukraine faces 'difficult' energy situation
summary: Ukrainian forces downed 105 out of the 134 drones, including jet-powered attack drones, launched by Russia overnight, the Air Force reported. Russian drones struck 20 different locations, and debris fell in 10 areas, according to the statement.
